items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-09-04
items.q: that's the last time I saw him was there outside the rhythm club

ctx.x: Well he said don't leave me here. He said he's always had six, seven, eight, or nine. Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Maybe they just gave him some.

Here's the name right here. Paul Howard is the greatest tenor that ever lived. But he used to have trouble with him. At first he couldn't play and all of a sudden he picked up and learned enthusiastic about anybody that he liked. So as I said that's the last time I saw him was there outside the rhythm club where he was all enthusiastic about his new band. But he was already sick and on the way out then I guess.
Maybe that's the reason he was a good band leader though to some
